row1.text: Pick reminder: push only, on or off

how.text: Texting is paused (PR #468), so Text is gone and the reminder is one switch: on = push to this phone, off = nothing. Press Play, then use the Scenario picker above each phone. In the Home Screen app, flip the switch to walk the iPhone prompt (Allow / Don't Allow). A problem replaces the one help line rather than adding a box.

open.text: Calls this needs from Jonah: (1) default is Off for everyone, since a saved Text reminder can no longer be delivered; (2) when push stops reaching a phone, the switch turns itself off (there is no text to fall back to); (3) the design system has no Switch, so the build adds one.
